title: Grand Diwali Mela In Edison
description: Experience the Magic of Diwali at the Grand Diwali Mela
long_description:
Experience the Magic of Diwali at the Grand Diwali Mela
Join us on the 25th of October, 2026, for the Grand Diwali Mela in Edison. Organized by Azim NJ Musik Waves, this celebration of lights promises a day full of joy, culture, and festivities. The event will be a vibrant mix of Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, and Urdu cultures. Expect a colorful exhibition showcasing the richness of Indian tradition, sumptuous food and drinks from diverse Indian cuisines, and soulful singing performances that will take you on a journey through the melodious landscapes of India.
Celebrating Diwali with the Maestros
While the event artist is yet to be announced, we can assure you that the performance will be nothing short of spectacular. The artist will be a renowned figure in the Indian music industry, well-versed in Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, and Urdu music. Stay tuned for the grand announcement of the artist and prepare to be enthralled by their captivating performances.
Immerse in the Festivities at the Parlor Banquet
The Grand Diwali Mela will be held at the Parlor Banquet, located at 2863 Woodbridge Avenue, Edison, NJ, United States. The venue is easily accessible, ensuring an effortless journey to the heart of the festival. The banquet is renowned for its safety measures and elegant atmosphere. What's more, its location in Edison, a city known for its Indian community, offers plenty of nearby attractions to explore. You can enjoy an authentic Indian meal at the many Indian restaurants in the vicinity before or after the event.
Secure Your Spot at the Grand Diwali Mela
Entry to this grand celebration is completely free of charge for both adults and kids under 12. However, we recommend securing your spot early to avoid missing out on this festive extravaganza. Come and join us at the Grand Diwali Mela in Edison. It's more than just an event – it's a celebration of culture, tradition, and the spirit of Diwali.
